classification_definitions.integration: Core observable assertion materially traverses genuine project service/API/network/process/store/runtime I/O.
classification_definitions.unit: Core assertion is local policy or synthetic/stub dependency behavior; SDK types and fake map readback do not establish external I/O.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct independent real-boundary and local-only assertion blocks coexist.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Source or mapping cannot support a complete category; runtime UNKNOWN is separate.

fake_store.reason: Every production ObjectStorageClient PutObject/GetObject is supplied by this test-only mutex/map implementation. Bodies are byte readers; RawResponse is constructed in memory. No SDK HTTP client or real store is created.

ledger_fixture.reason: newLedgerFixture constructs NewLedger with fakeObjectStorageClient and its currentTime; restart is another NewLedger reusing that same client.

signing_and_proofs.reason: Fixture signatures, intent/manifest/receipt/facts/candidate/progress and retirement data remain local. managedPeerRefresh deliberately constructs an in-process verified peer rather than a public founder-plan selection flow.

plan_fixture.reason: Plan-backed fixture also constructs NewLedger with fakeObjectStorageClient; refresh calls production AuthorizePeerRecovery over that synthetic storage state.

plan_fact_signatures.reason: Instance facts and signed receipt/result/HEAD are constructed locally; no OCI observation client is invoked.

seed_read_error_wrapper.reason: Wrapper synthesizes selected seed-receipt error or delegates to fake client.

founder_fixture.reason: Builds local signed plan/manifest bytes and typed topology; no endpoint is dialled.

founder_launch_fixture.reason: Launch authorization also injects the same map client; signs and reserves local bytes.

authority_fixture.reason: Test keys, release wires and manifest literals remain memory values. No material installation or Vault fetch is performed.

fake_plant.reason: Timestamp-test helper directly assigns fakeStoredObject into the mutex-protected map.

crash_delegate.reason: Crash is a panic after delegate PutObject, not a child process termination; delegate supplied by the fixture is the fake map.

crash_fixture.reason: Candidate wire and progress signer are local; simulated crash helper catches panic and reopens ledger over same wrapper.

crash_refresh.reason: Refresh callback authorizes recovery from the injected ledger state.

crash_reopen.reason: recover captures panic; NewLedger is called with same client rather than restarting any process.

client_interface.reason: Interface only; concrete client is chosen by the fixtures, not by SDK request type.

constructor.reason: Constructor validates/clones configuration and retains supplied ObjectStorageClient; it does not instantiate an OCI SDK transport.

immutable_write.reason: Writes build SDK-shaped requests and call the injected client, then exact-key readback through the same client.

exact_read.reason: Reads call injected GetObject and validate response byte reader and synthetic headers; no HTTP client is used here.

reserve.reason: ReserveSlot decodes local evidence, uses createOrRead/refreshCurrentIntent/writeInitialHead and ReadSlot over the supplied client.

slot_read.reason: ReadSlot invokes readSlot/recovery and maps quarantine to error; no external client choice changes.

launch.reason: Launch reads state/keys, rejects completed/external/pinned/uncommitted results, validates retry window and refreshes intent.

recovery.reason: Recovery reads through the same client, selects local phase and refreshes HEAD; monotonic elapsed time supplements the synthetic Date rather than providing an external server.

expiry.reason: Stored interval and whole-second expiry comparison operate on time values.

generic_result.reason: RecordResult has local managed/external mode guards before or around map reads; generic path does not authorize OCI provisioning.

external_seed.reason: RecordExternalSeed and ExternalSeedProgress verify local signed bytes and use ledger read/write methods over the supplied client; facts are caller-provided fixture structs.

managed_result.reason: RecordManagedPeer uses injected ledger reads/writes and caller-provided signing/refresh callbacks; no OCI observation API is invoked.

refresh_effect.reason: Freshness/identity/context checks are local calculations and context timeouts, not a process/runtime boundary.

advance.reason: AdvanceSlot validates retirement and successor identity and commits via injected object client; fixture retirement evidence is synthetic.

slot_state.reason: Read state validates exact HEAD/intent/proof relationships over injected reads; delegates managed state to managed_recovery.go.

head_write.reason: HEAD CAS is a request to injected client followed by exact-key readback, not proof of real object-store conditional semantics.

clock.reason: Result clock policy is arithmetic over Result and StoredRecord timestamps.

decode_intent.reason: Intent decoding checks scope, payload validation and signed regional pins locally.

intent_validation.reason: Required founder pins, mode combinations, region identity and canonical launch digest are local validation checks.

candidate.reason: Candidate recording and progress CAS call the same injected ledger write/read helpers.

progress_cas.reason: Managed progress CAS uses putObjectAfterTimestampBoundary and readObject over injected client.

managed_state.reason: Managed-state decoder reads map-backed manifest/candidate/progress/receipt/result and computes quarantine locally.

request_context.reason: RequestContext only wraps context; its use does not instantiate or run the SDK transport.

qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION; no compilation/test execution or runtime receipt review.

All ObjectStorageClient implementations reached by these roots terminate in an in-memory test map or an error/panic wrapper delegating to it; no real OCI SDK HTTP, persistent store or process restart is credited.

Cryptographic fixture calls were inspected as source only; no signing or cryptographic operation was executed for this review. Random key generation, typed InstanceFacts, signed retirement and server Date/ETag literals are fixture evidence, not cloud facts.
